meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 装上后,你的 macOS 菜单栏会出现一个闪电图标,用绿点/红点表示 NanoClaw 是否在运行;点击可启动、停止或重启服务。
howto.when: 当你在 macOS 上请 Claude 为 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加一个菜单栏状态图标
say.note: Claude 会编译并安装状态栏程序

say.text: 在 Mac 菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 的运行状态
say.note: 安装后菜单栏出现闪电图标

say.text: 帮 NanoClaw 做一个菜单栏启停按钮
say.note: 会创建并加载 launchd 服务

howto.what_en: After installation, a bolt icon appears in the macOS menu bar, showing NanoClaw's running status with a green/red dot; clicking it lets you start, stop, or restart the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw on macOS.

say_en.text: Add a menu bar status icon for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Claude compiles and installs the status bar app

say_en.text: Show NanoClaw's running status in the Mac menu bar
say_en.note: A bolt icon appears after install

say_en.text: Make a menu bar start/stop button for NanoClaw
say_en.note: Creates and loads the launchd service
